title: AI Core Framework
summary: This module provides the foundational components for building and operating AI agents, including core agent definitions, integrations with various large language models, extensible capabilities and tools, and essential utility functions. It forms the backbone for developing intelligent applications.

nodes.label: Agent Orchestration
nodes.title: Agent Orchestration & Core
nodes.description: Defines the core agent interface, declarative specifications, and the graph nodes for orchestrating agent runs, including user input, model requests, and tool execution.

nodes.label: Model Providers & Wrappers
nodes.title: LLM Providers & Wrappers
nodes.description: Provides abstract and concrete interfaces for various Large Language Models (LLMs) and their providers, enabling flexible model selection and interaction.

nodes.label: Capabilities & Tools
nodes.title: Agent Capabilities & Tools
nodes.description: Defines the core capabilities and tools agents can use, including mechanisms for discovery, execution, output processing, and lifecycle hooks to extend agent behavior.

nodes.label: Embeddings & Utilities
nodes.title: Embeddings & Core Utilities
nodes.description: Offers functionalities for generating text embeddings, managing concurrency, handling agent response streams, and providing general-purpose utilities.

groups.label: Agent Core
groups.title: Core Agent Components
groups.description: The central intelligence and control flow for building and managing AI agents.

groups.label: AI Service Integrations
groups.title: LLM & Tool Integrations
groups.description: Modules for integrating with various Large Language Models and providing extensible agent functionalities through capabilities and tools.

groups.label: Foundational Services
groups.title: Core Data & Utility Services
groups.description: Provides essential services for data processing, embedding generation, concurrency management, and general utility functions.
